title: context-budget.v1
description: Line budgets for generated `.mq/context` files, and the order they are rendered into each repo's token-budget.md. Owned by mqobsidian; consumed by this repo's generator and checker and by mq-agent context export. Every consumer indexes `budgets` by filename, so a name without a budget is a run-time KeyError -- validate-export enforces that coverage, which a schema alone cannot express.

budgets.description: Maximum line count per generated file. A budget is a ceiling, not a target.

rendered_order.description: Rows written into each repo's token-budget.md, in order. Every entry must have a budget.
